prompt: Create a production-ready transparent PNG game VFX spritesheet for a top-down 2D pixel-art RPG. A strict evenly spaced 4 by 4 atlas of sixteen square cells, four DIFFERENT motif rows and four temporal columns. Pixel art, not painted illustration: bold readable clusters, dark colored edge pixels, flat 5-tone ramps, crisp stepped silhouettes, no blur, NO painterly texture or dithering noise, no smooth gradients, no text, no icons or frames, no characters. Render each motif as if painstakingly drawn at 96x96 logical pixels. Transparent empty space must be at least 35% of every cell. Each effect centered inside its cell with generous 28 pixel clear padding on all four edges, no cells touch or bleed into neighbors. Columns temporal phases: gather small, release growing, impact sharp peak, dissolution fragmented. Conspicuously different poses in each column, not static shapes recolored. The central world remains visible through the effects. FIGHTER redesigned as a martial katana swordsman, ivory-silver cutting edge with restrained dark crimson and cool slate speed ink, no flames. Row1 directional curling katana sweep open 200-degree crescent with sharp tips; row2 a thin spear-shaped flying slash with three long speed trails pointing RIGHT; row3 crossing two ink blade cuts, tiny white central spark and long narrow diagonal ribbons, NO round explosion; row4 horizontal long razor fissure, perfectly white narrow core with asymmetrical severed ink strips above and below, NOT a fire blast. Martial kinetic precision.
